main.description: Redeem an invite from admin.createInvites: the caller joins the customers space with read access, and the address the invite went to is paired with the caller's account. Redeeming as an account that is already a customer succeeds and spends nothing. Any signed-in account may call this; the token is the authority.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID, new for each attempt; a retry reuses it.

joined.description: Whether this call made the caller a customer. False when they already were, in which case the invite was not spent.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: token is missing or malformed, or idempotencyKey is not a UUID.

errors.name: InvalidInvite
errors.description: No invite has this token, or it is not an invite to the customers space.

errors.name: InviteUsed
errors.description: The invite has already been redeemed, or was revoked.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The customers space is not configured, or the invite could not be redeemed.
